title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description: Job Description Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required Reports to: Account Manager and CTO Contract Type: CLT About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations. Position Summary: The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively. Position duties and responsibilities: Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality. Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance. Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support. Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms. Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively. Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups. Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations. Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities. Qualification and requirements: Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules. Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting. Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting. Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills. Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication. Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments. Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus. Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued. LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion. Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps: Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to   with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician. Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English. Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps. Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Crewing Assistant
description: About the Role We are looking for a Crewing Assistant to support our growing operations in Brazil. You will work closely with the Crew Planner, Crewing Coordinator, and Crewing Officer to ensure all crew joining our vessels are fully prepared and compliant. What You Will Do Support the processing of flag-state applications (endorsements, seaman’s books, etc.) Coordinate visa requests and travel documentation for crew Assist in preparing and processing POs for crew changes and training Handle documentation for onboarding and pre-employment checks Ensure all data is accurately recorded and kept up to date in the system Liaise with internal teams to support crew scheduling and logistics What You Bring Strong attention to detail and accuracy Experience in administrative roles, preferably in crewing or maritime operations Knowledge of STCW, MLC, ISM, ISPS, CBA, and flag-state regulations (preferred) Proficiency in English Ability to work with standard office equipment and systems Ability to coordinate multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment Why Join Us This is an opportunity to be part of a growing regional team supporting key operational activities. You will play an essential role in ensuring our crews are prepared, compliant, and ready to sail.

Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores. Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas. IV. Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure. Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design. Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento. Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Chief Engineer (Process Safety)
description: Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate. Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation Role Description Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc. Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs. Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required. Review third-party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required. Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings. Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements. Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment. Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects. Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects. Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects. Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule. Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports. Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality. Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university. Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor. Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects. Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.). Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms). Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register). Hands-on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.G., SIMOPS, ALARP). Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc. Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes. A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter-discipline communication skills.

title: Analista Administrativo De Obras
description:
A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela. Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Administrativo de Obra (Financeiro) para atuar em nossa obra, um projeto com alto volume de controle e exigência de detalhamento junto ao cliente. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), organizado(a) e com atenção aos detalhes, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos administrativos e financeiros da obra. Principais atividades da função: .Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;
.Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;
.Verificar se as retenções de impostos (PCC, IR, INSS) estão de acordo com o ensinado e devolver ao fornecedor quando houver divergências;
.Verificar o CNAE na nota fiscal do fornecedor, assegurando que esteja compatível com o serviço prestado;
.Conferir o endereço da obra nas notas fiscais, garantindo que esteja conforme o solicitado pelo cliente;
.Cobrar as apropriações da engenharia para lançamento das APs e controle financeiro;
.Emitir e conferir relatórios de pedidos de compra em aberto, boletins de medição e saldos de contratos, cobrando notas fiscais correspondentes;
.Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;
.Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;
.Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;
.Emitir e conferir relatório “Administração de Obras”, montar RP e enviar ao financeiro corporativo com as notas e documentos exigidos pelo cliente;
.Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;
.Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;
.Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;
.No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;
.Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia. Pré-requisitos: .Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;
.Experiência anteriorem rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;
.Excel intermediário ou avançado;
.Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;
.Facilidade de comunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas. Desejável: .Conhecimento em Sienge;
.Experiência emobras com múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;
.Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;
.Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira. Outras informações: .Regime: CLT .Carga Horária: 44 horas semanais - Presencial (segunda a sexta-feira) .Local: Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro .Benefícios: vale assiduidade, plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e vale-transporte

title: Encarregado De Logística
description:
Dover Fueling Solutions ("DFS"), uma empresa Dover (NYSE: DOV) composta pelos negócios ClearView, Fairbanks, ProGauge, Tokheim, Wayne Fueling Systems e OPW's Fuel Management Systems, oferece equipamentos avançados de abastecimento de combustíveis, sistemas eletrônicos e pagamento, medição automática de tanques e soluções de gerenciamento de estoque de líquidos para clientes em todo o mundo. Sediada em Austin, Texas, a DFS tem uma presença global significativa, incluindo instalações nos EUA, Reino Unido, Holanda, Suécia, França, Índia, China e Brasil. Para obter mais informações, visite. Sumário: Coordenar as atividades do setor de logística, distribuir e orientar os serviços do Almoxarifado e Revenda, abrangendo o recebimento e armazenamento de peças nacionais e importadas, garantindo a acuracidade do estoque e os devidos registros de movimentações, acompanhar as atividades de expedição de peças e produtos acabados para o mercado interno e exportação, controlar todo o fluxo do processo de armazenagem dos armazéns internos e externos, coordenar as atividades de separação, embalagem e envio de peças e produtos de automação e intercompany, e processos de reparos eletrônicos com o objetivo de garantir a reposição de peças em campo e buscar soluções para eventuais problemas que possam ocorrer. Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de almoxarifado: Supervisionar a contagem cíclica e acompanhar as devidas análises bem como, tratativas das divergências quando necessário. Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
Acompanhar asrotinas de recebimento e programar junto ao time de compras os recebimentos diários, a fim de adequar a capacidade de recebimento a demanda;
Garantir a gestão do fluxo de recebimento e armazenamento de materiais, garantindo acuracidade da conferência, movimentação física e sistêmica dos itens recebidos, e eliminar divergências de estoque e ajustes financeiros desnecessários;
Analisar junto ao time de Sourcing e Qualidade o melhor tipo de embalagem para os produtos recebidos a fim de garantir o melhor uso de espaço do armazém, facilitando assim a conferência, armazenagem e garantindo a conservação do produto durante o transporte e no armazém;
Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
Participar dereuniõescom a área de planejamento referente a programação de produção dos pedidos de revenda e monitorar estoque/itens em almoxarifado de peças fora de linha;
Garantir a continuidade do programa 5S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato. Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de Revenda Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
Identificar necessidades prioritárias de expedição de produtos acabados, coordenar a movimentação, armazenamento e organização dos materiais a serem expedidos, e coordenar todo o fluxo de saldos de produtos acabados internamente e em armazéns externos. Realizar interface / acompanhamento, controles e negociações de prazos com empresas de transporte/correios, bem como elaborar indicador de desempenho de performance de transportadoras;
Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
Acompanhar entrada depedidos de revenda, automação e pedidos intercompany, garantindo o atendimento aos prazos estabelecidos, bem como controlar a base de dados e todas as informações pertinentes aos processos de expedição e logística reversa;
Garantir a continuidade do programa 5S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato. Conhecimentos especificos / Habilidades: Conhecimentos em ERP (preferência Oracle);
Conhecimentosem Excel(preferência Avançado);
Conhecimentosem Armazenagem e Frete;
Habilidade decomunicação / Liderança, Planejamento e relacionamento Interpessoal. Qualificações básicas / formação: Ensino Médio completo ou Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia Produção, logística ou afins.

title: Assessor Técnico I (Projetos De Inteligência Artificial - Ia) - Temporária
description: VAGA TEMPORÁRIA Você acredita no poder da educação para transformar vidas? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time! Identificar oportunidades de integrar soluções de Inteligência Artificial aos sistemas e plataformas de dados, em colaboração com as equipes técnicas a partir da identificação de oportunidades de análises avançadas, com definição do problema de negócio e dos indicadores-chave, para apoiar iniciativas educacionais e gerar valor estratégico para a instituição. Preparar relatórios executivos de governança interna (ex: cronograma físico-financeiro, status report, curva S), na perspectiva de negócio, que consolidem informações de status, riscos, resultados e impactos das iniciativas, subsidiando a tomada de decisão das instâncias de governança e decisão. Realizar a gestão administrativa do contrato, validando a conformidade das entregas técnicas em relação aos marcos, critérios de qualidade e condições de pagamento previamente estabelecidas, subsidiando as tomadas de decisão. Organizar, detalhar necessidades das áreas educacionais, traduzindo e refinando requisitos e critérios junto às áreas de negócio e TI, assegurando clareza, consistência e completude das informações fornecidas aos fornecedores para a adequada execução das atividades da área, a fim de subsidiar a atuação das equipes técnicas e fornecedores. Facilitar a adoção de práticas ágeis entre as equipes, garantindo a compreensão e aplicação correta dos princípios e cerimônias. Monitorar riscos do projeto, sinalizando desvios de prazo, custo ou escopo para a gestão imediata e propor planos de ação corretivos. Garantir que a documentação funcional e técnica entregue pelo fornecedor atenda aos padrões exigidos pela governança da instituição. Articular e facilitar a interface com áreas internas parceiras, antecipando demandas e viabilizando acessos, aprovações, validações e demais trâmites necessários para assegurar a execução contínua dos projetos. Executar outras atividades correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalente grau de responsabilidade e complexidade. Conhecimentos Técnicos: Gestão de Projetos (PMBOK e Scrum). Ferramentas de gestão de tarefas (ex: Monday, Trello, Jira) e Pacote Office avançado. Junte-se a nós e ajude a transformar vidas todos os dias!

title: Diploma Em Anatomia E Fisiologia Humana
description: Este curso vai inicialmente introduzir você à fisioterapia. Você estudará sua história, assim como aprenderá a diferença entre um fisioterapeuta e um auxiliar de fisioterapia. Em seguida, o curso abordará os déficits tratados pela fisioterapia, que incluem amplitude de movimento (ADM), força e equilíbrio. Você conhecerá as oportunidades de carreira e as habilidades exigidas para um fisioterapeuta, além de aprender sobre o trabalho cotidiano de um auxiliar de fisioterapia. Depois, explorará a terminologia médica, os movimentos corporais e os planos de movimento, além de entender por que não se deve usar muitas abreviações médicas. O curso também discutirá os equipamentos gerais usados em fisioterapia e ensinará sobre órteses. Por fim, você aprenderá sobre os tratamentos de distúrbios médicos comuns, incluindo distúrbios da amplitude de movimento, como a ADM do cotovelo. Aqui, também estudará as diversas formas de modalidades de tratamento, como a massagem com gelo. Criar um ambiente confortável para pacientes em recuperação de lesões, junto com a prestação de cuidados vitais em fisioterapia, é exatamente o que os pacientes precisam para recuperar os movimentos e controlar a dor. Este curso de Introdução aos Auxiliares em Fisioterapia proporcionará uma compreensão melhor das funções e responsabilidades desse profissional. Comece agora e aprenda como você pode desempenhar um papel essencial no cuidado e tratamento de pacientes que necessitam de fisioterapia.

title: Diploma Em Saúde Mental: Psicologia E Bem-Estar
description: A prevalência e o impacto dos problemas de saúde mental no bem-estar de crianças e jovens é alarmante. Este curso de psicologia infantil aborda os fatores de desenvolvimento que influenciam a saúde mental de crianças e adolescentes. Identificamos os sinais e riscos de transtornos mentais antes de apresentar os fatores de proteção que podem mitigar seus sintomas. Descrevemos as ferramentas e processos usados para avaliar a saúde mental e estabelecemos o valor da colaboração entre as partes interessadas. O curso explora as considerações éticas levadas em conta quando profissionais de saúde mental trabalham com crianças. Em seguida, exploramos estratégias de intervenção e opções de tratamento usadas para gerenciar os sintomas dos problemas de saúde mental. Estudamos o autocuidado, estratégias de enfrentamento e outras terapias usadas por cuidadores, conselheiros e psicólogos para melhorar a saúde mental. O curso explica como criar um ambiente de apoio que promove a resiliência em adolescentes. Mostramos como cuidadores podem estabelecer empatia com os jovens para identificar casos precocemente e administrar o tratamento adequado. Este curso de saúde mental oferece estratégias para analisar as influências culturais e sociais no bem-estar mental das crianças. Também destacamos os benefícios de adotar uma abordagem culturalmente sensível para o manejo dos problemas mentais. Este curso de psicologia ensina como acessar serviços adequados de saúde mental para ajudar pacientes e conhecidos. Discutimos também como escolas, comunidades e órgãos governamentais podem apoiar jovens com transtornos mentais. Este curso é ideal para profissionais de saúde mental, cuidadores, professores e pais. Inscreva-se para aprender como atuar ativamente na ajuda aos jovens para identificar e gerir sintomas de saúde mental por meio de autocuidado e tratamentos clínicos.

title: Auxiliar De Cozinha
description: Uma coisa que une as pessoas ao redor do mundo é a comida. Diversas culinárias, sabores e ingredientes formam a base da indústria de preparação de alimentos. Como em muitas profissões, um conjunto de regras, técnicas e políticas padrão deve ser aplicado durante o preparo dos alimentos. Este curso de serviço de alimentação examina as políticas e fluxos de trabalho da indústria de preparação de alimentos. Primeiro, identificamos várias ferramentas culinárias e explicamos como usá-las para desempenhar suas funções. A importância das práticas de higiene e segurança alimentar muitas vezes é subestimada. Discutimos como a higiene e a segurança dos alimentos impactam a saúde humana e afetam a frescura e o sabor dos alimentos preparados. O curso apresenta uma abordagem simples para planejamento de cardápio e desenvolvimento de receitas. Em seguida, exploramos o mundo da seleção, manuseio e cuidado com facas, demonstrando várias técnicas de corte. Abordamos os componentes fundamentais da excelência culinária, incluindo preparo de caldos, molhos e sopas. Chefs profissionais utilizam diversas técnicas para cozinhar legumes, frutas, carnes e frutos do mar. Focamos nas abordagens mais básicas que podem ser aplicadas a qualquer prato. Explicamos como cozinhar massas perfeitamente com o método "al dente" e destacamos a importância de manter medidas precisas ao assar. Por fim, discutimos a seleção e preparo de frutos do mar. Este curso de serviço de alimentação é ideal para aspirantes a chefs e auxiliares de preparação, e para qualquer pessoa que goste de usar a criatividade na cozinha. Inscreva-se para aprender a se tornar um auxiliar de preparação de alimentos.

title: Enfermeiro
description: Nosso curso abrangente começa definindo o papel dos enfermeiros no tratamento da saúde mental, explorando os diversos fatores de risco que podem levar a condições mentais e examinando o papel dos enfermeiros no tratamento da saúde mental. Você obterá uma compreensão profunda dos diferentes transtornos mentais, seus sinais iniciais e a importância do diagnóstico preciso e do tratamento eficaz. Aprenderá estratégias práticas para ajudar os pacientes em sua saúde mental, incluindo dicas sobre exercícios, dieta, sono e técnicas de relaxamento. Este curso também aborda a questão crítica do estigma em saúde mental e oferece conselhos práticos sobre como superá-lo ao iniciar sua carreira como enfermeiro. Cobrimos os aspectos essenciais da psicoterapia, incluindo o que faz um bom terapeuta e os riscos e precauções potenciais associados ao tratamento. Além disso, o curso trata das necessidades e desafios enfrentados por pacientes e suas famílias, equipando você com conhecimento para oferecer melhor suporte e cuidado. Para quem tem interesse em uma carreira na enfermagem em saúde mental, nosso curso oferece uma visão completa da profissão. Você aprenderá sobre os papéis e responsabilidades dos enfermeiros em saúde mental, enfermeiros de prática avançada e a jornada para se tornar um enfermeiro. Este curso tem como objetivo capacitá-lo com o conhecimento e habilidades necessários para influenciar positivamente o campo da saúde mental, seja como profissional ou defensor informado.

title: TECNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO
description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores;
Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações; 
Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais;

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino médio completo;  Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho; Registro MTE. Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho. Jornada: escala 12×36 (diurno ou noturno)

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - OptimisationJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Host City Manager – Brasília
description:
Department: Government Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host City Manager – Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines. The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas. The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities. The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília. Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.
Your Profile Education
  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.
Experience
  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).
Behavioral Competencies
  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.
Differentials
  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in Brasília or able to relocate there independently

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Realiza vistorias nos equipamentos utilizados pelos vigilantes, como rádios comunicadores, lanternas, sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando corretamente e que os profissionais estejam com os EPIs e materiais exigidos para a função.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

About Mode Mobile

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This senior‑level, high‑ownership role requires a proven product leader with business acumen, operational excellence, and user empathy.

  • Conduct ongoing experimentation, user and competitor research to support strategic decision making that drives monetization and user growth
  • Provide visibility into business performance and communicate results clearly to executive stakeholders and the broader organization
  • Serve as a role model and standard‑setter for product excellence for your cross‑function team
Who You Are
  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business

  • A natural collaborator who communicates effectively across all levels of the organization

  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness, and consistently follow through on commitments
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact
  • Caring: Genuinely care about people, the business, and the mission, and strive to create a positive, supportive environment

Qualifications

  • Experience in mobile app ecosystems, with strong understanding of subscription, IAP, and IAA monetization strategies (utility, rewarded, social, or gaming apps is a plus)

  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data tools such as Mixpanel, Google Sheets, and business performance dashboards

Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to guide us
  • Assume positive intent
  • Agree to disagree & commit
  • Set new precedents
  • Accomplish more with less
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards
  • Speak up
  • Be resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 rule
What We Are Offering

  • A competitive compensation package

  • Weekly Wednesday "Get Stuff Done Days" (no meetings)

  • 10 annual Wellness Fridays
Next Steps

If we just described the role you want and your ideal team, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to creating success together!

Equal Employment Opportunity

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.

You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Coun
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in‑house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and the Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers’ compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment‑related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in‑house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in‑house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy. The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment‑related and labor‑related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in‑house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in‑house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters. Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership. The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective‑bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi‑legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed. Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions. Responds to University officials’ request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility. Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University. Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems. Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action. Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures. Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies. Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics. Ability to participate effectively in fact‑finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations. Ability to articulate the University’s position, listen and negotiate effectively. Superior verbal and written communication skills. Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision. Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines. Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process. A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience. All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

Skills

Regulatory Environment; Leadership; Strategic Influence; Regulatory Advocacy; Regulatory Issues; organization; Analytical Thinking; Active Listening; Food Sciences; Food Technology; Risk Management; Communication; Government Affairs; Regulatory Policies; Taking Initiative; Cross-Functional Teamwork

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Senior Legal Counsel Main responsibilities
  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.
Required qualifications
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English ; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.
Preferred experience
  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors .
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions , especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties , state‑owned entities , or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance .
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.
What success looks like in this role
  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrófica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

A Michelin, líder do segmento de pneus, se dedica ao desenvolvimento da mobilidade de seus clientes, de forma sustentável, criando e distribuindo os pneus, serviços e soluções mais adequados às suas necessidades, fornecendo serviços digitais, mapas e guias, para ajudar a tornar suas viagens experiências únicas; e desenvolvendo materiais de alta tecnologia, que atendem à indústria da mobilidade.

Defendemos nossos valores de respeito aos clientes, às pessoas, aos acionistas, ao meio ambiente e aos fatos em todos os lugares onde estamos presentes.

Nós nos importamos em dar as pessoas uma melhor maneira de seguir em frente.

Com a mesma atenção aos nossos colaboradores e clientes, nós inovamos além e melhor pela sustentabilidade.

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.
What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Responsável pelo desenvolvimento da engenharia de processos da área de Novos Negócios com foco na elaboração de Capex e Opex de soluções para novos clientes industriais do Pipe Line da Apura.
  • Apoiar a área Operacional com avaliação e soluções de engenharia de processo de plantas em operação da Apura.
  • Atua em projetos de engenharia no escopo de análise técnica de propostas e projetos conceituais e executivos de tratamento de água e esgoto.
  • Dimensionamento de processos com foco em tratamento com membranas de Ultrafiltração, Osmose Reversa e outras (Lodos ativados, MBR, BRC, UASB, Filtros).
Requisitos e qualificações
  1. Tratamento de água e efluentes indústrias.
  2. Tratamento para Reuso de Efluentes.
  3. Imprescindível experiência com tratamento com membranas de Ultrafiltração, Osmose Reversa e outras.
  4. Inglês intermediário, desejável fluente.
  5. Espanhol intermediário, desejável fluente.
  6. Experiência: Operação e controle de plantas de tratamento de água ou efluentes (Imprescindível com membranas).
  7. Dimensionamento com custos de CAPEX de plantas de tratamento de água ou efluentes (preferencialmente com membranas).
  8. Dimensionamento com custos de OPEX de plantas de tratamento de água ou efluentes (preferencialmente com membranas).
  9. Análises químicas em laboratório.
  10. Testes de bancadas de tratabilidade de efluentes ou água.
  11. Excel intermediário, desejável avançado.
  12. Power BI intermediário, desejável avançado.
  13. Conhecimentos em simuladores de Osmose e Ultrafiltração de fornecedores de membrana (desejável).
Informações adicionais
